answer: A farm running 151 keys therefore pays for 151 separate budgets, and each of them has to be real to survive a spot-check of the river declaration. Because the ocean audit recomputes usage from the haven history, a padded declaration is a losing trade rather than a inexpensive one. Each identity declares a compute budget of 478 units per epoch and the declaration is bound to its signing key, so two identities cannot share one budget without a visible collision. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
